title: 용 세트 솔로 #091 · 아랍·얼음 용(눈동자 최대)·혀 선홍·독니 은 밴드+앞니 다이아 · P15 · 배경 순흑 · 기반 `la_facesculpt_050`
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the middle of her chest, her whole shoulders, collarbones and chest in view, the frame cutting off below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Early 30s.

Subject: A striking adult Arab woman — Arab elegant beauty with warm olive skin and real visible pores, early 30s, long straight espresso-brown hair with a centre part behind both ears, a full makeup: a matte base, sharp contour, long lashes and glossy black lipstick, real ice dragon eyes: enormous glossy pale glacier-blue irises about twice the size of a natural iris, each iris filling the whole eye opening edge to edge from corner to corner and from upper lid to lower lid so that the eyes read as one large field of colour, with a razor-thin vertical slit pupil, jet black, running the full height of each eye, tiny frost-white diamond-shaped scale marks flanking the slit and a faint pale-blue glow around the pupil, both eyes the same, the colour solidly saturated across the whole iris with a darker ring around its edge, a wet glassy shine on the surface of each eye, set in her ordinary human eyelids and sitting clear of the eyelid edges, a wide-eyed, startled look — a photograph of a real Arab woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her face is natural and beautiful: a soft round face with full cheeks, a softly rounded nose and a gently curved mouth. Face irezumi: a traditional Japanese irezumi tattoo in bold black ink outlines with vivid colour fills covers her forehead: a coiling dragon in ice blue and silver with black-edged scales, white snowflakes and clouds, its body winding across the whole forehead from one temple to the other, its head raised at the centre of the forehead above the brows; it is real tattooed skin with the pores and peach-fuzz visible through the ink, the piercings, henna and stickers sit on top of the inked skin wherever they overlap, and her eyes and eyelids stay bare real skin. Eyeshadow: her eyeshadow is a snake-scale makeup in ice blue, frost white and silver, a smooth gradient across the whole eyelid from the lash line up to the brow bone, with a sharp, narrow, upswept winged liner in a black-silver that ends in a long fine point at the outer corner and a faint shimmer of tiny scale-like glitter on the outer third of the lid; it sits on the lids as ordinary eyeshadow on her real skin with the pores and peach-fuzz visible, and the eyeballs and lashes stay natural. Dragon horns: two slender dragon horns grow from the sides of her forehead at the hairline, one above each temple, each horn rising a short way and then sweeping smoothly backward along the side of her head, lying low and close to her skull like swept-back antlers and ending in a fine curved point above and behind her ear, each about as long as her hand, a carved horn of clear glacier-blue ice, translucent and glossy like real ice, with fine frosted ridges running along its length and a pale white frost-tipped point; the base of each horn grows out of her real skin with a small natural ring of skin around it, the two horns are the same, and they frame her face as two slim curved horns on either side of her head, above her forehead tattoo and beside her swept-back hair. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with one or two small natural beauty marks, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, an uneven natural skin tone with a faint flush across the cheeks and around the nostrils, tiny visible pores on the nose and chin and fine natural vertical lines in the lips, real wet catchlights in the eyes and individual hair strands catching the light. Her skin is matte and natural, her forehead, nose and cheeks showing visible pores, fine skin texture and peach-fuzz with a soft, matte, dry-looking natural sheen, and the real skin around her brows, lips and the edges of her scales shows the same pores and texture. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her lips are the star of her face (the shape, size and projection described here override the lips of her makeup, while the lip colour and finish follow her makeup and ignore any lip colour named here): the absolute extreme of a 'wide mouth': a mouth so wide that its corners stretch out to the line below the outer corners of her eyes, spanning almost the full width of her lower face, the lips long, full and generously plump, a smooth, long, perfectly drawn horizontal mouth with a gently curved upper lip line, mirror-glossy deep rose with bright white highlights along both lips, every edge razor-crisp, perfectly symmetrical, so that the lips are by far the dominant feature of her face in this view, still reading as a beautiful, believable human face, never smudged past the lip line; her nose: a high, straight, refined, surgically sculpted nose: a tall, slim, straight bridge, a narrow, pointed, projecting tip and clearly narrow nostril wings with slim, neat nostrils; her jawline and chin: an extreme, razor-sharp V-line: the cheeks taper in a long, smooth, straight diagonal from the ears down to a small, narrow, pointed chin, a very slim lower face with a sharply defined sculpted jaw edge. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque. Her brows are a dragon's brow ridges: above each eye a raised ridge of small overlapping ice-blue scales with silver-white frosted edges and tiny pointed spines along its top follows the line of the brow and sweeps outward and upward at the outer end into one short, fine, curved spine, so that each brow reads as a scaled ridge in the shape of a natural brow, sitting on the brow bone below the forehead tattoo, with the real skin of her forehead and eyelids around it and the pores visible. Her cheeks: from each side of her nose grow two long, fine, silver-white dragon whiskers that sweep out across the cheeks and back toward her ears in graceful curves, the jawline and chin staying bare real skin. Her lips and mouth: her lips are a dragon's lips, a row of small, smooth, glossy ice-blue scales with fine silver edges covering the whole of both the upper lip and the lower lip from one corner of her mouth to the other and following the outline of each lip, so that her upper lip and her lower lip both read as scaled ice-blue lips, and from each corner of her mouth a fine silver line curls upward and outward across the cheek in a graceful flourish, about as long as a thumb, like a dragon's wide mouth line (this replaces any lip colour described above). Her lips are slightly parted and a real snake's tongue slides out through the gap between them and extends far out: an extremely thin, round, smooth cord as slim as a shoelace from its base to its tips, split from the tips back almost to its base into two hair-fine, needle-sharp prongs, each as fine as a thick strand of hair, held in a narrow V in the air and hanging well past her chin down to the base of her throat, bright scarlet red, glossy and wet-looking like a real snake's tongue, the whole thin tongue clearly visible against her skin and in sharp focus. Her lips part wide enough to show two long, slender, curved venomous fangs that descend from her upper jaw on either side of the centre, ivory-white with a glossy wet sheen and a thin silver band around the base of each fang, each as long as her lower lip is tall and tapering to a needle-sharp point, in sharp focus beside the tongue. The upper front teeth show too, each one set with a tiny round diamond at its centre, small white gems glinting in a neat row. Below her neck: everything from the base of her neck downward is a dragon's skin instead of human skin, so that her whole body below the neck is scaled like a real dragon's body: both shoulders, both collarbones, the hollow between them, the centre of her chest and the whole upper chest, from one shoulder to the other and from the neck down to the bottom edge of the frame, are covered edge to edge in one continuous, unbroken layer of ice-blue dragon scales, each scale rounded and edged with a fine silver line, glossy and frosted like polished ice and a little larger toward the shoulders, the scales running right across the middle of her chest in the same size and pattern as on the shoulders, real scales with each scale clearly visible; the scaled skin begins at a clean line around the base of her neck, while her face and neck stay real human skin with the pores and peach-fuzz visible; her long thin tongue stands out clearly against the scales.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about ten in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, the upper opening holding a gigantic multi-tier waterfall chandelier earring, a large classic round O-ring hoop in the lobe with three stacked tiers of marquise and teardrop gem drops cascading from it, each tier wider than the last, as wide as her palm and as long as her hand, hanging freely in the air down to the level of her collarbone and no lower, and the lower opening holding one very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit one thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; one small stud across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; one small stud along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The left and right sides are balanced. The pieces are spread over the whole face in clear rows so every one reads individually, with bare skin between them; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. The ornate earring and the weights hang side by side from the two openings without touching or hiding each other. All the ear weights hang from the bottom of the lower iron ring, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly five separate massive weights, each of a different shape and a different metal, all of them rough, hammered, matte and unpolished, each hanging on its own thick heavy chain of the same metal as the weight: on the left ear dull blue-grey lead a round bell on a shortest chain, dull dark brass a teardrop-shaped sinker on a short chain, dark patinated bronze a miniature anvil on a medium chain, tarnished dark silver a pyramid-shaped lump on a long chain, rough-cast matte yellow gold a barrel-shaped weight on a longer chain; on the right ear dull pewter-grey tin a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a shortest chain, oxidized dark copper a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a short chain, dull dark brass a miniature anvil on a medium chain, rough-cast matte yellow gold a teardrop-shaped sinker on a long chain, tarnished dark silver a barrel-shaped weight on a longer chain. On each ear the lower iron ring carries its own column of 5 weights on chains of different lengths, staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid lump of metal at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, rough and matte and unpolished with no shine and no delicate or thin parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the chains hanging freely in the air, clear of her neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of her collarbones, never below them and never resting on her chest or body. Because the load is shared between two openings, the weight gently pulls each earlobe down a little into a slightly elongated, soft, healthy loop of skin, only a small natural droop that is just enough to show how heavy the weights are; the lobe never stretches long, never tears or collapses and never hangs down to her neck or shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The face and ear jewelry is real blackened steel set with small clear diamonds, one-colour, restrained, while the hanging weights are always rough, matte, unpolished heavy metal in mixed materials (lead, tin, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass and iron), sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
